description: This file defines a React functional component named OfflineSubscription that manages offline subscription activation, removal, and UI interactions within the application.

methods.name: shouldShowOfflineSubscription
methods.description: Determines whether the offline subscription UI should be displayed based on application features and previous user actions.

methods.name: handleSubscriptionCodeSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the offline subscription code, activating or showing an error message based on the result.

methods.name: handleRemoveOfflineKey
methods.description: Removes the offline feature repository and resets related state.

methods.name: handleRemoveClick
methods.description: Handles user confirmation and triggers offline key removal.
